newsitem.title: USA: UST Inc to boost moist smokeless prices.
newsitem.headline: UST Inc to boost moist smokeless prices.

text.p: UST Inc said it will boost the prices of its moist smokeless tobacco products about 3.2 percent beginning Monday, December 16.
The move stems from "an increase in the cost of doing business," said Alan Kaiser, a UST spokesman.

Moist smokeless tobacco sales accounted for about $1.1 billion -- or 83 percent -- of UST's roughly $1.32 billion in 1995 revenue, he said. The company's moist smokeless tobacco products include, among other brand names, Copenhagen and Skoal.
UST has about an 80 percent share of the $1.38 billion market for moist smokeless tobacco, said Allan Kaplan, a Merrill Lynch tobacco analyst.
The increase should prompt UST competitors -- most of them small, privately held companies -- to boost prices of their moist smokeless tobacco products, he said.
Officials at other makers of moist smokeless tobacco products had not yet heard about UST's move, or were not available to comment.
Swisher International Group Inc, which sells its moist smokeless tobacco under the Silver Creek and other brand names, declined to comment.
